newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia gathers 42.3 mln T grain by Monday - ministry.
newsitem.headline: Russia gathers 42.3 mln T grain by Monday - ministry.

text.p: Russia had harvested 42.3 million tonnes of grain by Monday from 25 million hectares out of a total sown area of 54 million hectares, a Russian Agriculture Ministry official said on Monday.
"This year the tempo of harvesting has so far been higher than in 1995," Ivan Gridasov, head of the plant growing department at the Agriculture Ministry, told Reuters.
But Gridasov declined to give any figures for harvesting in the same period last year.
Gridasov said the harvest this year would be 10-12 million tonnes higher than last year's 63.4 million tonnes.
Last week Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Zaveryukha forecast a grain harvest this year of 77 million tonnes, but independent forecasters say it is more likely to be around 70 million tonnes.
